purpose: Contrast flight routing with actual facility siting and land allocation. Authored semantic targets, not live results.

cases.title: Routing remedy is not a facility judgment
cases.response: The hum would ruin my sleep. Keep flights above the freight district instead of our houses; only then could I accept the noise. I support urgent medical deliveries.

cases.title: Actual landing-site objection despite acceptable overflight
cases.response: The flights overhead are acceptable to me. But I oppose putting the landing pad beside our school: use the existing depot instead, and I could accept that facility location.

cases.title: Actual land allocation and acceptable noise
cases.response: The drone sound is acceptable to me. I would accept the land allocation only if the community garden is protected from construction.

cases.title: Flight avoidance for physical safety does not imply ground facilities
cases.response: I cannot live with the risk of a drone injuring my children at home. Fly away from our house; I could accept a corridor elsewhere. The aircraft appearance is acceptable to me.
